items.text:
Pocket Flashlight
          At the end of every Scuffle, recover 6 Courage.

Spare Batteries
          Draw 1 extra Trick on your first turn of every Scuffle.

Friendship Bracelet
          Gain 1 Guard at the start of every turn for each Keepsake you carry.

Welcome Mat
          Gain 4 Guard at the start of every Scuffle.

House Slippers
          The first attack against you each Scuffle deals 3 less damage.

Brass Service Bell
          The first time each Scuffle you end a turn with 0 Nerve, draw 1 extra Trick next turn.

Chewed Tennis Ball
          The first Attack you play each Scuffle deals 8 more damage.

Jar of Fireflies
          The first time your Guard breaks each Scuffle, gain 6 Guard and draw 1 Trick.

Butterfly Net
          Every 10th Trick you play in a Scuffle, draw 2.

Sticky Hand
          Whenever you Vanish a Trick, gain 2 Guard.

Lucky Button
          Rare Trick rewards appear noticeably more often.

Chalk Stub
          Unsurveyed rooms on the blueprint show what they really are.

Thermos of Cocoa
          Safe Rooms restore an extra 12 Courage.

Wind-Up Mouse
          Every third Trick you play in a turn grants 4 Guard.

Moth-Eaten Monocle
          Enemies begin every Scuffle with 1 Vulnerable.

Nightlight
          Attacks that would deal 5 or less damage to you deal 1 instead.

Porcupine Slipper
          Gain 3 Bristle at the start of every Scuffle.

Coatcheck Ticket
          On your first turn of every Scuffle, put your most expensive Trick back on the bottom of your draw pile and draw a replacement.

Spare Key
          Curiosities show you one extra way through. The locked option is never locked to you.

Knotted Handkerchief
          The first debuff applied to you each Scuffle is refused.

Tin of Sardines
          Whenever an enemy is defeated, recover 3 Courage. Something always comes to eat.

Ninth Life Charm
          The first time you would run out of Courage each Scuffle, survive at 1 instead.

Night-Before Bag
          Draw 2 extra Tricks on your first turn of every Scuffle.

Stopped Pocket Watch
          Gain 1 extra Nerve on each of your first three turns of a Scuffle.
